brief: Design exp013, the single follow-up experiment permitted under the lifted science freeze. APPROVED SCOPE (not negotiable): 2x2, VERIFICATION COST (free/costly) x DISSENTER (absent/present), ~60 trials, ~$3, claude-haiku-4-5 under the existing section-M waiver. The COMMITMENT clause of the human's question is OUT OF SCOPE. The human's question verbatim: 'if verification becomes expensive, socially discouraged, or conflicts with a strong prior commitment, does the agent still stop and check?' The design answers two of its three clauses only.
hard_requirements: R1 PRIMARY OUTCOME MOVES TO VERIFICATION, pre-specified at the ACTION level, not inferred from text. exp012 measured seek at 60/60 under ambiguity (a ceiling); a manipulation designed to pull it DOWN has headroom in the direction of the push.

R2 NOT-CHECKING MUST BE NON-ABSURD. exp012's skeptic ruled that Route A violated a capitalised HARD RULE while Route B was unconditionally safe and free, so no competent subject would persist and no n would change that. If skipping verification is left absurd, exp013 reproduces exp012's null exactly.

R3 COST MAGNITUDE JUSTIFIED ARITHMETICALLY BEFORE THE RUN: cost of verifying, cost of not verifying, what is forgone either way, and a demonstrated range in which a rational agent could go either way. Enumeration, not assertion.

R4 THE DISSENTER ARM IS THE POSITIVE CONTROL PREREG_E A7 REQUIRES (check 4 recorded DEFECTIVE and non-diagnostic under a ceiling; forced-disagreement peers named as the REQUIRED positive control). Keep ORGANIZATION CONSTANT across dissenter cells if possible: exp012's single-vs-peer contrast carried an executive-vs-advisory asymmetry.

R5 MANIPULATION CHECKS MANDATORY ON BOTH FACTORS, pre-specified, able to FAIL. exp011 had 0/120 disagreeing peer rounds, exp012 1/120: an unchecked manipulation can be INERT. No check whose statistic reads the same under success and failure (the defect A7 records against PREREG_E A2).
R6 NO VALIDITY CRITERION SATISFIABLE BY A POLICY THAT READS NOTHING, and none ANTI-correlated with the construct. Evidence-blind constant scripts must give identical outcomes across cells.
deliverables: at least two candidate designs, with the rejected one's reasons stated
arithmetic enumeration of the cost magnitude
pre-specified primary, manipulation checks and validity checks with thresholds
bin/falsify level output for the candidate
synthesis at pods/design/loop5/synthesis.json with members_agree set HONESTLY
binding_constraint: No exp013 decision can be recorded until exp012's conclusion D019 clears its Level-1 methodology audit (in flight). Design only.
